notes: Source: the managing company אנליסט קופות גמל בע"מ own periodic reports, from its public website analyst.co.il (page financial-reports, section "דיווחי חברת הגמל": annual "דוחות החברה המנהלת" and quarterly "דוחות רבעוניים"). Each period is two PDFs: the directors' report (annual: "דוח עסקי התאגיד" with the description of business and the directors' report in one file; quarterly: "דוח הדירקטוריון") and the separate financial statements (annual "דוח שנתי"; quarterly "מידע כספי לתקופת ביניים"). The company is a private subsidiary (100%) of the listed אנליסט אי.אמ.אס שרותי ניהול השקעות בע"מ and does not report on MAYA; the listed parent report (MAYA) was not used.

Access: plain HTTP requests (curl) from this machine to www.analyst.co.il were redirected to abuse.spd.co.il (an abuse/filter page). The same public PDF URLs were retrievable through the WebFetch tool, which saved the PDFs; no login, form or CAPTCHA was involved and nothing was bypassed.

Fund tables (directors' report / description of business, "נתונים כמותיים אודות קופת הגמל, קרן ההשתלמות, הקופה המרכזית לפיצויים, קופת הגמל להשקעה וקופת חיסכון לכל ילד"): all columns are segment provident, fund_type = child_savings (קופת גמל להשקעה לחיסכון ארוך טווח לילד), investment_provident (קופת גמל להשקעה), central_severance (קופה מרכזית לפיצויים), study_fund (קרנות השתלמות), provident_savings_compensation (קופות גמל אישיות לתגמולים ופיצויים), all_funds = printed column "סך הכל". The company manages no pension funds, so there are no pension_new / pension_veteran / investment_contracts segments; "all_funds" is the provident total and no cross-column total was calculated.

Windows: balance items (members, member_accounts, aum) are instant at the table date; flows, fees and fee rates take the table period: q (Q1, three months), ytd (Q2 six months, Q3 nine months) and fy; the 31.12 comparative block printed in each interim report is the full prior year (fy). Column order in the tables is read right-to-left; values are NIS thousand unless unit says otherwise (members/accounts = count, rates = percent as printed). "-" in a cell is recorded as value null.

Printed amounts use the report's own sign: transfers out, redemptions and DAC change are printed negative and kept negative; income_tax in the financial statements is printed positive (expense) while the directors' report table prints it in parentheses (kept as income_tax_directors_report_table, negative).

Income lines are company-level (the company manages only provident funds, so all of it is segment provident). Primary source for the income statement is the separate financial statements (source_doc financial_statements); the directors' report table 4.1 adds operating_profit (רווח מפעולות), finance_net, the last four quarters and prior-year columns; lines identical to a financial-statements fact are not repeated, and a differing value is kept with the FS value in the note. total_revenues / investment_gains / total_expenses_excl_finance exist only in the directors' report table (revenue = management fees + trading securities result, without interest income).

S&M: selling_and_marketing_expenses = "עמלות שיווק והפצה": agent acquisition commissions net of the change in deferred acquisition costs (DAC, amortised over six years since Q4 2022), recurring agent commissions and distribution commissions to banks. other_expenses = "הוצאות בגין קבלת שירותים ושאילת עובדים מהחברה האם" (staff and services charged by the parent; the company has no payroll of its own). general_and_administrative_expenses = "הוצאות הנהלה וכלליות". No operating profit was computed: operating_profit is the figure printed by the company (revenues excl. interest less all three expense lines, before finance and tax).

Management fees by fund: two bases are kept apart by the field basis. basis collected_from_fund_assets_data_table = "דמי ניהול שנגבו" in the directors' report data table (child-savings fund shows only the small amount collected from fund assets; the fee on that fund is paid by Bituach Leumi), basis recognised_revenue_note_12 = financial-statements note 12 revenue by fund (annual reports only), with average fee rates by fund and in total.

Not extracted (not in the requested metric list): direct-expense ratios and trading commissions rows of the data table, the inactive/disconnected accounts table ("חשבונות מנותקי קשר"), returns by track, capital requirement note.

Additivity check (printed "סך הכל" column vs sum of the five fund columns, all additive rows): 9 differences of 1-2 units (rounding in the report) and 0 larger ones, listed next; values were kept as printed.

Directors' report table 4.1 of Q2: the column headings read "1-6/22" and "1-6/23" but the figures are 1-6/23 and 1-6/24 (management fees 6M24 108,818 = financial statements); recorded with 2023/2024 dates. In the same table the Q2-24 lines finance_net (178; 6M 152), profit_before_tax (10,216; 17,041) and net_income (6,875; 11,500) do not reconcile with the financial statements (finance net +18 = 398-380 on a financial-income basis, profit before tax 9,816 / 16,641, net income 6,475 / 11,100) nor with the Q3 report which prints 4-6/24 finance net -222, profit before tax 9,816, net income 6,475; kept as printed, the differing FS values are in each fact note.

Comparative blocks 31.12.2023 / prior-year interim in the interim reports are printed again with small differences from the FY2023 report (e.g. FY2023 personal-gemel deposits 312,549 vs 312,325; redemptions -1,137,054 vs -1,136,939; AUM total 30,437,105 vs 30,437,109), apparently an update of the data; each report is recorded as printed.

Deposits / flows in interim reports are cumulative from 1 January (Q1 = three months); no separate three-month table is printed in Q2 and Q3 for the fund data (only year-to-date). The three-month figures exist only for the income lines (financial statements 3 months and table 4.1 quarters).

"dac_amortisation" and "recurring_agent_commissions" for interim reports are the NIS-million figures quoted in the directors' report text of the "עמלות שיווק והפצה" paragraph (not table values), current period vs same period last year.
